description: Change Illustrator preferences. They persist, as if set in the Preferences dialog. Pass an object of name: value

cornerRadius.description: Default corner radius for rounded rectangles, in points

keyboardIncrement.description: Distance an arrow key moves a selection, in points

penAutoAddDelete.description: Disable the Pen tool's automatic add/delete anchor (true disables it)

scaleStrokesAndEffects.description: Scale stroke weights and effects when scaling objects

showHandlesOnSelectedAnchors.description: Show direction handles when several anchor points are selected (Selection & Anchor Display)

showPixelGrid.description: Show the pixel grid at high zoom

smartGuidesLabels.description: Smart Guides: anchor and path labels

usePreviewBounds.description: Measure objects including stroke width and effects (General > Use Preview Bounds)

name: set_preferences
title: Set Preferences
